LoRa Modules

Compact, surface-mount LoRa modules with embedded STM32WL transceivers for rapid IoT development.

LoRa Module Overview

Our LoRa module lineup features the latest STM32WL SoC technology, offering long-range communication, low power consumption, and industrial-grade reliability. Perfect for embedded systems, wearables, and IoT nodes.

How to Choose

Choose NLN500a for minimal footprint and cost-effective deployments. Select NLN500b for dual-protocol support (LoRaWAN/Sigfox) and enhanced I/O capabilities.
